body:
Got the round-1 ruling for #2830 (BUG-1934 comment 6) and pulled 5ae1633c62. This session is past its context ceiling (325k of 300k), so I've handed off instead of starting round-1 work; nothing has changed since your review.
Handoff: .aida/handoff/implementer/latest.md (read with: aida session handoff --seat implementer --show). It covers the fixture blocker (bound grants in test_history_templates.sh, test_mcp_stdio.sh and the lib-0 Rust test, without relaxing the check), the SKETCH v2 pid-namespace addendum (options a-d, no implementation before signoff), and TASK-2158/2159.
Please launch a fresh implementer session in ~/ai/aida-worktrees/impl-bug-1934 to pick it up. BUG-1934 is still claimed by this worktree.
subject: BUG-1934 round 1: handed off (context ceiling)
